issue: GEM carries this government land-based Matarbari LNG terminal (Rupantarita Prakritik Gas Co [100%], 7.5 MTPA) as 'cancelled' (gem.wiki: 'With no updates as of 2025, the project was inferred cancelled'). New reporting (June 2026) indicates renewed activity, not cancellation: Tokyo Gas (consultant since 2020) has COMPLETED a full feasibility study for the 7.5 MTPA land-based Matarbari terminal, including bid packages and RfPs; Petrobangla chairman states the ~1,000 mmcfd land-based terminal 'is now a priority', to be developed on a 20-year BOOT basis (contractor not yet selected). Project status may warrant moving back from cancelled toward proposed/shelved with an updated timeline.
suggested_action: Route to Update: re-verify lifecycle status of RPGC Matarbari LNG Terminal. Feasibility study complete + RfP prep is a concrete step; reconsider 'cancelled' inference. No BOOT contractor identified yet, so do NOT add an Owner beyond the existing government/RPGC entity. fetch_timeline is DOWN this batch — defer the timeline edit, capture the status change here. Confirm this is the same project as gem.wiki 'Matarbari LNG Terminal' (RPGC, 7.5 MTPA, US$1bn) and disambiguate from the separate cancelled 'Matarbari GE LNG Terminal' (PBDB/GE) and 'Summit Matarbari LNG Terminal' (proposed).
